profile.headline: May, 2018 Grad | Biology, Anthropology & ES | Seeking Opportunities in Biology, Ecology, and Web Development

positions.title: Environmental specialist II
positions.description: Performs specialized technical field and office work involving research, environmental sampling and inspection/enforcement activities to ensure compliance with stormwater and environmental codes of the City/State/Federal government. Perform water quality analysis with data management and project development to mitigate impaired surface waters and downstream impacts.

positions.title: Environmental Specialist
positions.description: Environmental specialist dealing with water quality and compliance management.

positions.title: Emergency Medical Technician
positions.description: Provided patient care as clinician on ambulance. Performed vitals assessments and treatment of patients in transport. Communicated with hospital support staff and reviewed patient charts.

positions.title: Behavioral Health Technician
positions.description: Monitored and continually assessed individuals on the behavioral unit. Liaison between patient and physicians. Inspected patient charts to continue best practice of care.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Analyzed and compiled GPS locations and quantitative data into excel file on Eckerd College tree species’

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Assessed species trade, release, and expected environmental impact of the marbled crayfish
Researched and wrote a Policy Brief to manage the invasive species of marbled crayfish in the Southeastern U.S States

positions.description:
Completed research on the density of plant species for controlled burns in Boyd Hill Nature Preserve
